Lojban++ is a language invented by Ben Goertzel which replaces the form of Lojban predicates with English words.
{{quotation|... in a very rough sense, it may perhaps be understood as a pidgin of Lojban and English. Lojban++ is less elegant than Lojban but no more difficult (and perhaps easier) to learn, and much easier to use in domains to which Lojban vocabulary has not yet been extended. In short, the goal of Lojban++ is to combine the mathematical precision and pragmatic ontology that characterize Lojban, with the usability of a natural language like English with its extensive vocabulary|Ben Goertzel<ref>http://goertzel.org/agi-13/Lojban_paper_v1.pdf</ref>}}

As of December 2014 no users of Lojban++ have been reported.
